mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET resolution_status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND resolution_status = 'OPEN' AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
